title: Vegan Drumsticks from Yuba (Tofu Skin) — Rehydration, Wrapping, and Air Fryer Finish
summary: In this Goodful video, Merle attempts to craft vegan drumsticks using yuba (tofu skin). The process covers slicing frozen yuba, rehydrating it in water, wringing out excess moisture, and seasoning with a bouillon-based mix plus five-spice. Strips are wrapped around a core with a cornstarch slurry to resemble drumsticks, chilled briefly, and then glazed and finished in an air fryer at 325°F (160°C). The result is four formed pieces with a notable skin-like texture and color, which Merle rates highly and suggests as a crowd-pleasing vegan option. The video also references fellow creator Woon Hang for recipe inspiration.
topics: wringing/release of moisture from rehydrated yuba
glaze composition (water, soy sauce, molasses/dark soy sauce, maple syrup)
vegan poultry alternatives and crowd-pleasing potential
reference to Woon Hang recipe (vegan unagi)

sections.title: Intro and premise
sections.description: Merle introduces the goal of making vegan drumsticks from yuba, notes high audience interest, and mentions prior content and collaborator inspiration.

sections.title: Yuba prep and rehydration
concepts: draining and wringing to remove moisture
sections.description: Yuba is described as soy-milk skin; the strips are rehydrated in water, then gently wrung out to reduce water content before seasoning.

sections.title: Seasoning and cornstarch preparation
sections.description: A seasoning mix is prepared with bouillon, spices, and sugar, plus a cornstarch slurry to help bind the coating.

sections.title: Drumstick assembly and wrapping
concepts: wrapping yuba strips around the core
thicker end to mimic real drumstick
sections.description: Each yuba strip is coated with slurry and wrapped around to form a drumstick-like shape; Merle emphasizes making the end thicker for realism.

sections.title: Chilling and glaze prep
concepts: glaze components prep (water, soy sauce, molasses or dark soy sauce for color, maple syrup)
sections.description: Wrapped sticks are refrigerated to set the shape while a glaze is prepared separately for later application.

sections.title: Air fryer finish
sections.description: The formed sticks are placed in the air fryer basket and cooked at 325°F (160°C) to finish the dish.

sections.title: Results, texture, and closing reflections
concepts: gratitude to collaborator and invitation for future recipes
sections.description: Merle assesses the finished product, remarks on texture and appearance with a high rating, riffs on serving ideas, and thanks Woon Hang for inspiration.
